text:
Morgan - People Ops: quick help — Jamal wants a hire's salary and title effective 2026-05-01 but start is 2026-05-14. can we make salary effective earlier and what paperwork do we need? cc @Priya @Elena

Jamal - Eng Manager: manager prefers retro 5/1 to match team's headcount budget. candidate signed offer lists 5/14. they'd like SWE II -> SWE III and salary bump.

Elena - Comp: salary retro doable in many locations w/ signed amendment. we typically pro-rate by days. equity cannot be backdated if it changes eligibility.

Priya - Payroll: operationally need signed amendment, approved backpay calc, payroll reason code and country tax check. cutoff for May manual is 2026-05-25 PST. sample command we use:

```
payroll_manual_adjust --eid 009876 --period 2026-05 --retro_start 2026-05-01 --amount 950.00 --note "OC retro salary"
```

Don't run until People Ops confirms docs. Also large retro payments can affect withholding; payroll will advise.

Alex - HRBP: benefits start = hire date (5/14). we cannot retro-enroll. Title can be set retro in HRIS if amendment says so, but call it out to candidate.

Lina - Legal EMEA: heads up for EMEA: many countries require employment on the retro period to remit taxes. If they weren't on payroll, we may need to treat the amount as a one-time sign-on or file special forms. Send country and contract and we'll confirm. Include tax liability language in amendment.

Jamal - Eng Manager: got it. one practical q: do we pro-rate using days in month or daily/365? we want the exact calc to tell finance.

Elena - Comp: we default to daily using 365 unless comp policy states otherwise. formula we use: ((new_annual - old_annual)/365) * days_prior. days_prior = days from effective_date through day before start. Example: 5/1 -> 5/13 = 13 days.

people-bot: Reminder: payroll cutoff 2026-05-25 23:59 PST :bell:

Morgan - People Ops: action items: 1) Jamal attach signed amendment to candidate folder and ping here. 2) Elena will post backpay calc. 3) Jamal to include country for Legal check. 4) Priya to confirm run window once docs are ready. I'll close once payroll executes. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
